About the Project

Cambridge's CREATES NERC doctoral funding supports environmental research through eligible courses and projects. The funding deadline depends on the course, so applicants need to match the proposed research to the correct admission route before submitting.

Research Areas

  • Environmental science
  • Earth science
  • Climate research

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salary£21,805/year (UKRI minimum stipend 2026/27)

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsApply by the relevant course funding deadline; programme stages differ.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration roundCourse-specific: 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027
LocationUnited Kingdom

About University of Cambridge

Cambridge offers research degrees through its departments and colleges. Doctoral training programmes in sensors, environmental science and cardiovascular research have their own selection and funding arrangements alongside university admission.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

2026/27 UKRI reference rate: the minimum UKRI doctoral stipend is £21,805 per year, tax-free (London institutions +£2,000), effective 1 October 2026.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://nercdtp.esc.cam.ac.uk/prospective-students/how-apply-updated-2026-entry

Source: nercdtp.esc.cam.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 8 December 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: Course-specific: 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
